item.description: The parse_url method in NotifyBase class doesn't properly validate and exclude invalid format values. When an invalid format is provided (like 'invalid'), it should not be included in the returned results, but currently the default value is kept.
item.contract: The parse_url method should validate format values against valid NOTIFY_FORMATS and only include them in results if they are valid. Invalid format values should be removed from results and not replaced with defaults.
item.acceptance: test_notify_base_urls in tests/test_notify_base.py should pass, specifically the assertions that check format=invalid is not in results and format=text is properly included.

item.description: The parse_url method doesn't properly validate and exclude invalid overflow values. When an invalid overflow is provided, it should not be included in the results.
item.contract: The parse_url method should validate overflow values against valid OVERFLOW_MODES and only include them in results if they are valid. Invalid overflow values should be removed from results and not replaced with defaults.
item.acceptance: test_notify_base_urls in tests/test_notify_base.py should pass, specifically the assertions that check overflow=invalid is not in results and overflow=upstream is properly included.

item.description: Missing emoji handling in parse_url method. The method should properly process and validate emojis parameter.
item.contract: The parse_url method should handle the emojis parameter correctly, parsing boolean values from query string and including them in results.
item.acceptance: test_notify_emoji_general in tests/test_plugin_base_formatting.py should pass, particularly the emoji interpretation tests.
